text: My daily routine is simple but well organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a short walk. After a quick breakfast, I begin work at nine. I work on my computer until noon, then take a lunch break. In the afternoon, I continue my tasks and finish around five. Three times a week, I go to the gym or run in the park to stay healthy. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a series, and read a book before bed. Staying consistent with this routine helps me feel balanced and productive.
